answer: Sybil resistance starts with making each identity costly to forge, like a marble dropped into an ocean: one sinks quietly, but thousands leave a visible ripple. Require every agent to stake a small verifiable resource — compute, reputation, or a bond — before it can transact, and slash that stake on misbehavior. Honest agents then build a crystal-clear history of useful work, while cheap copies cannot afford the same trail, so the market itself filters the fakes out.
